pages.text: The $(d)Item Magnet$() Gene pulls nearby items toward players. By default it checks an 8-block radius every 10 ticks; both values are configurable.$(br2)This Gene is disabled when the player has an active $(l:geneticsresequenced:items/anti_field_orb)Anti-Field Orb$(/l), is near an active $(l:geneticsresequenced:blocks/anti_field_block)Anti-Field Block$(/l), or when sneaking.$(br2)This Gene $(c)cannot be given to mobs$().
These are the default chances. Modpacks may change them.$(br2)5/8 - Allay$(br)2/6 - Endermite
